name: Piko
source: Furukawa Makiko was Genki's childhood friend. One day she said goodbye to him, mentioning that she was leaving for good. After many years Makiko appeared at the school where the protagonist works. But for some reason she didn't recognize him and prefers to be called Piko. In addition, her appearance hasn't changed after all these years. So, what are the secrets she's hiding?
